task: Draft a 60–90-word case-reading note for a mock legal seminar, not advice about real law. Use the fictional holding and reserved question below. For this Bluebook 22 exercise, the venue supplies the complete permitted citation: Ternhaven v. Upland Depot, 41 Fict. App. 203, 211 (N. Reach Ct. App. 2022). facts.text: The fictional majority in Ternhaven v. Upland Depot required a countersigned delivery record for the disputed municipal rental invoice under the contract clause before it.
At page 211, the majority expressly reserved whether an electronic scan would satisfy that clause.
Case record: Ternhaven v. Upland Depot; 41 Fict. App. 203; pinpoint 211; N. Reach Ct. App.; 2022.
No material about any real jurisdiction, later decision, or present legal rule is supplied.
